_comment: Read by scripts/adapters/trenitalia-gtfs.mjs (registry id `italian`). Every Intercity Notte in Trenitalia's national GTFS is taken — the category is the allowlist, as route_type 105 is for Trafiklab — so a new night train appears without an edit here. stationNames pins the name a station is published under where the feed's own spelling differs from the one the map, the connection pages and their URLs already use (Viaggiatreno's); keyed by GTFS stop_id, which is Viaggiatreno's station code without the S.
